title: The exact reconstruction threshold for the three-state symmetric channel
main_claim: For the 3-state symmetric (Potts) channel on b-ary trees (b≥2) and Poisson(d) Galton–Watson trees (d>1), reconstruction holds iff dλ²>1, with non-reconstruction at equality for both signs, including the coloring channel λ=-1/2 at d=4. Corollary: the exact weak-recovery threshold for the symmetric 3-community SBM.
coverage: Section 2 foundations, checked by hand: Bayes tilt, density evolution, reverse-martingale limit and fixed point, linear-estimator second-moment recurrence, degradation kernels, survival bound. Section 3, positive equality: re-derived the J and B additivity identities, the entropy identity, the Q-identities, the 37/27 bound, the Jensen step, the correlation lemma (regular and Poisson), the g bound and the three λ-cases. A numeric scan of T-8/5 stays positive. Appendix radial: sympy confirms the N(1) factorization, the N0 and L certificates and the p-substitution polynomials; mpmath confirms the G formula, G≥12x² and the radial inequality. The derivation of R, N and the L expansion from G was not re-derived symbolically, so it rests on these numeric checks. Section 4 local gap: re-checked every rational constant and the directions of the substitutions; Monte Carlo found no violation of the pair inequalities. Section 5: verified the weighted identities, the h and z bounds and the ξ lower bound; a numeric spot-check of P>0 across the three bands was positive. Section 6: checked the refinement and completion lemmas and read grid.cpp against the text (tables, spreading, Taylor weights, bins and corner domination). The full official reproduce.py replay passed (summary.json passed=true; iteration outputs match the paper, e.g. regular 162, Poisson 99–104). The UBSan interval check was not run. The SBM corollary was not independently checked; it relies on the external Mossel–Sly–Sohn and Abbe–Sandon results.
